name: HDC Pulse Data Model ERD
notes: This file formalizes both existing Supabase tables and implicit React mock-data objects.
Calendar events use the corrected target language: label, rhythm, lifecycle. The current database table is public.waypoints and should migrate toward this shape during the Pulse pass.
Status for work objects belongs to the source work item. Calendar events only carry lifecycle unless they need to display sourceStatus as a denormalized read hint.

missingData.gap: Mock users use string ids like u1, while Supabase profiles require auth.users UUIDs. Production seed data needs stable auth/profile UUID mapping.
Departments are mostly strings in mock data. They need seeded Department records and every Profile, Workplan, Priority, Metric, Huddle, and CalendarEvent should reference departmentId.

Actual Q2 key objectives are nested under mock priorities. They need their own KeyObjective rows with priorityId, ownerId, departmentId, workplanId, and WorkObjectAssignment rows for secondary owners/support.

Department workplans exist as front-end objects, but nested Q2 objective workplan fields are not consistently linked by workplanId. Create canonical Workplan records, then attach KeyObjective and Priority rows.

Calendar mock source ids include legacy examples like p1 that do not match the real q2-* priority ids. Calendar sources need to be remapped to actual Priority, ActionItem, ChecklistSubmission, or Workplan ids.

The first migration now carries label, rhythm, lifecycle, sourceStatus, and a direct nullable actionItemId. Remaining work is front-end consumer cleanup where old mock objects still refer to representation.

Curb Appeal submissions are not yet materialized as calendar events. Each submission should create a CalendarEvent with label Commitment, rhythm quarterly, lifecycle scheduled, sourceType checklist_submission, and sourceId submission.id.
Property managers exist in curbAppealPropertyManagers but are not linked to Profile ids or property_assignments. Production needs profile records and property assignment rows.
Property operations are current snapshot fields only. If trend/history is needed, add metric records or a property_operations_snapshots table.
Huddles currently have recurrence and timing but no member rows in mock data. huddle_members should be seeded.
Action items now support direct workplanId and priorityId links. Weekly priority task-derived mock items still need canonical IDs and persistence rows before production.
Review workflows are implicit in WaypointContext and CurbAppealContext. Production should create ReviewRequest rows for org-calendar approvals and checklist review/follow-up.
Teams/adaptive-card tables exist, but mock data does not include Teams account mappings, notification events, delivery rows, or card responses.

NotificationEvent is now formalized, but application triggers still need to be added when a stuck is issued, an action item is assigned, a deadline is approaching, a task is overdue, or a review/escalation is requested.
